items.title: NEP-667: External Contract Calls
items.summary: A draft would let a smart contract decide how to authorise a call and pay its execution cost, rather than requiring the caller to supply a normal NEAR account signature.

items.title: NEP-649: Deterministic ML-DSA-65 Key Derivation from BIP-39 Seeds (SLIP-0010)
items.summary: The proposal describes a common way for wallets to derive ML-DSA-65 keys from a recovery phrase. Its pull-request description links to the technical specification.

items.title: NEP-645: specify the ML-DSA-65 secret-key string encoding
items.summary: An amendment proposes a consistent text format for ML-DSA-65 secret keys, addressing incompatibility between NEAR developer tools.

items.title: NEP-666: Post-Quantum Signature Verification Interface
items.summary: A proposed contract standard defines how smart contracts request verification of specified post-quantum signatures.

items.title: NEP-665: Panic-Free Contention State for Contracts
items.summary: A proposed contract standard describes how to represent conflicting evidence without crashing or simply overwriting earlier evidence.

items.title: NEP-635: specify that messages shorter than 16 bytes are rejected
items.summary: A specification amendment would document the implementation’s existing handling of messages shorter than 16 bytes.

items.title: NEP-636: Sharded Fungible Token
items.summary: A draft discusses a sharded fungible-token standard. The pull-request description says the proposal text is still a work in progress.

items.title: NEP-641: non-normative clarifications from a second implementation
items.summary: Clarifications to NEP-641 aim to remove ambiguity around timestamps, data encoding and signature-verification details identified by another implementation.
